purpose: Development-ready data package matching the current Figma scientific values
rules: Scientific numeric values must not be hard-coded in React/chart components.
Use numeric 'value' for calculations and 'display' for the Italian UI label.
Do not interpret 89% AlphaMissense as clinical accuracy.
Do not interpret the TCGA immune subtypes as response probabilities.
CheXpert AUROC values are pathology-specific; there is no single universal CheXpert AUC.
